title: NASA Saturn satellite sheet: Iapetus (VIII) mass 18.1×10^20 kg, radius 746 x 746 x 712 km
summary: The Saturn satellite fact sheet lists Iapetus (VIII) at mass 18.1 × 10^20 kg and radius 746 x 746 x 712 km.
body: NASA's Saturn satellite fact sheet lists Iapetus (VIII) with mass 18.1 × 10^20 kg, radius 746 x 746 x 712 km, mean density 1090 kg/m^3, and visual geometric albedo 0.05 / 0.5. Orbital parameters on the same sheet: Semi-major axis (10 3 km) = 3,560.85; Semi-major axis (Saturnian Radii) = 59.091; Orbital Period* (days) = 79.330183; Rotation Period (days) = S; Inclination (degrees) = 14.72; Eccentricity = 0.0283. These are the cells printed on the sheet. The sheet does not say, on this row, which cells are a spacecraft measurement and which are an estimate. The sheet says R indicates retrograde motion, and S indicates synchronous rotation, the rotation period equal to the orbital period. Author of the sheet: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Last Updated line: 22 July 2025.
